categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor parsing in src/script/descriptor.cpp and extended key decoding, which governs wallet key and descriptor management.
categories.rationale: Optimizes ParseDescriptor by eliminating redundant Base58Check decodings and using a checksum lookup table, achieving a ~30–36% speedup on extended keys. Microbenchmarks show ParseDescriptor dropping from 127 µs to 90 µs on a 20-of-20 Taproot multisig descriptor, providing concrete benefits for wallet descriptor parsing and fuzz targets.
